QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Karen's Warning
QuestInfo.0: Go to #bKaren#k in the #bTime Control Room#k and present the #b<Chronicles of Ellin Forest>#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Karen felt a faint power of time emanating from the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest> and allowed you to cross the Gate of Time.
Go to the #bCamp Entrance#k in Ellin Forest and talk to the person there.
QuestInfo.2:
Karen warned you that the #rset history should never be changed#k and allowed you to go to the past.
As soon as you crossed the Gate of Time, you arrived in Ellin Forest - the Victoria Island of centuries past.
The first person you met was a half-elf repairing something.

0.msg: Didn't you want to cross the Gate of Time? Use the portal at the top to go to the past.
